leads.name: Ginger Batiks
leads.why: 安邦，做了 10 年；外籍客人为主；自己办圣诞市集；没有网站
leads.verify: IG 简介有没有网站链接；最近有没有发圣诞市集
leads.input:
Ginger Batiks · Instagram @gingerbatiks · Ampang, Kuala Lumpur
Hand block-printed 100% cotton (some silk) homeware and gifts: cushions, pouches, handbags, towels, blankets, kids' toys. Founder Kim Gruia (Canadian, in Malaysia 11 years).
Signals: 2025 was the brand's 10th year. Private home boutique by appointment (booked via Instagram). Runs the Ginger & Spice Markets twice a year (spring and Christmas). Also sold on consignment in other shops.
Budget signal: 10 years in business, expat customer base, consignment stockists, organises her own markets.
Website: none found (gingerbatiks.com / .com.my / .my do not resolve).
Observation (from The Edge / Options feature, Apr–May 2025): entering her 10th year; customers book private boutique visits through Instagram; the Christmas Ginger & Spice Market is her big season.
Angle: let customers browse and order between markets, and send gifts overseas (expat customers shipping home).

leads.name: Ministry of Cakes
leads.why: 八打灵，2015 年开始；有咖啡馆 + 上课工作室；花钱上过 Vulcan Post
leads.verify: IG 简介有没有网站或订蛋糕链接
leads.input:
Ministry of Cakes · Instagram @ministry.of.cakes · Petaling Jaya
Custom buttercream cakes; best seller Gulab Jamun Cheesecake. Started 2015 as 'Caked', rebranded 2017. Run by Lakhshmi Priya.
Signals: physical café with kitchen, a studio for baking classes and private events; online orders started on Facebook and Instagram; plans for bottled iced coffee and ready-to-bake items.
Budget signal: 10 years running, physical café + class studio, paid for a sponsored Vulcan Post feature (May 2024).
Website: none found (ministryofcakes.com / .com.my / .my do not resolve).
Observation (from the Vulcan Post feature, May 2024): the café doubles as a class studio and the Gulab Jamun Cheesecake is the top seller.
Angle: online custom-cake orders (size, flavour, pickup date with lead time) and class booking with payment.

leads.name: Best Borneo
leads.why: 古晋 Voco 酒店楼下的礼品店（2026-07 开）；网站还在「Under Construction」
leads.verify: 网站可能已经有人在做——开场白先问一句
leads.input:
Best Borneo · Instagram @bestborneosarawak · Kuching, ground floor of Voco Kuching (Wisma Elica)
Curated Sarawak gift store: Bowerhaus accessories, woven bags by Penan Women Project, illustrated postcards, kek lapis, brandy fruitcake, Libex coffee, four heirloom rice varieties (Bario, Etem, Bajong, Bireh).
Founders: Datin Shen-Tel Lee (co-founder of jewellery label Bowerhaus) and restaurateur Olivia Ling. Opened end of July 2026, open daily.
Budget signal: retail store inside a hotel building; founders run other established brands.
Website: bestborneo.com.my currently shows only 'Website Under Construction' — someone may already be building it, so ask politely first.
Observation (from The Edge / Options feature, Aug 2026): the heirloom rice is sold individually or as a set of four, and the store mixes crafts with edible Sarawak treats.
Angle: visitors can reorder after leaving Kuching; festive / corporate gift sets. Ask if they already have someone building the site.

leads.name: Habitatku + Loulou
leads.why: 同一对夫妻：Habitatku 蜡烛在中央艺术坊有店，Loulou 卖东南亚手作服饰；两个都没有网站
leads.verify: 找 Habitatku 的 IG；看 Loulou 简介有没有网站
leads.input:
Loulou (Instagram @louloulookbook) and Habitatku (candle brand with a store in Central Market, Kuala Lumpur) · same founders: husband-and-wife Philippe Bertrand and Valerie Khoo
Loulou: handmade skirts and bags in bold Ankara prints from makers in Thailand, Indonesia, Vietnam and Malaysia; only a few pieces arrive each week (e.g. one maker makes four chicken bags a week). Customers are typically mid-30s to 70s.
Budget signal: physical candle store in Central Market (tourist footfall); customer base aged 35–70.
Website: none found for either brand (habitatku / loulou domains do not resolve or are parked).
Observation (from The Edge / Options feature, Jul 2025): Loulou focuses on one designer at a time and each batch of skirts has 20 different patterns.
Angle: one site for both brands; tourists who bought candles at Central Market can reorder; weekly new arrivals for Loulou.

leads.name: Dimpled
leads.why: SS2 意式冰淇淋店（2024 开）；每周新口味；pint RM38–41
leads.verify: IG 简介有没有订购链接
leads.input:
Dimpled · Instagram @dimpledmy · 151, Jalan SS 2/6, SS2, Petaling Jaya
Gelato shop opened 6 June 2024 by Eugenia, who left a 10-year job in Singapore to open it. 2–3 new flavours every week (Honey Milk, Sea Salt Sakura, Espresso Stracciatella).
Pints around RM38–41 (2024 data).
Budget signal: physical shop, premium pricing.
Website: none found.
Observation (from Vulcan Post Aug 2024 and Grazia Feb 2025): weekly rotating flavours; Sea Salt Sakura and Honey Milk get mentioned a lot.
Angle: weekly flavour menu online + pint pre-orders with delivery / pickup time slots; gift cards.

leads.name: Forest Floor
leads.why: 茶味意式冰淇淋，Damansara Utama 有店；用 WhatsApp 接单；pint RM38
leads.verify: 先确认最近还有发文、店还在
leads.input:
Forest Floor · Instagram @forestfloor.my · Damansara Utama, Petaling Jaya (57, Jalan SS 21/1a — confirm still open)
Tea-based gelato (pu-erh, ceremonial matcha). Founded by Shawn Low and Lai Jen Yeh; started in Cheras, moved to Damansara Utama.
Pints RM38; orders taken through a WhatsApp link (2024 data).
Budget signal: physical shop, premium pricing.
Website: none found.
Observation (from Vulcan Post Aug 2024): they take pint orders through a WhatsApp link.
Angle: replace WhatsApp ordering with an online menu that takes payment and delivery slots; tea gift boxes.

leads.name: Artigusto Gelato
leads.why: Taman Paramount 意式冰淇淋（2024 年底开）；以前的网站已经过期
leads.verify: 看 IG 简介是不是还放着过期的网站链接
leads.input:
Artigusto Gelato · Instagram @artigustogelato · 37, Jalan 20/16, Taman Paramount, Petaling Jaya
Artisanal gelato (Salted Pistachio, Bentong Ginger Chocolate, non-alcoholic Tiramisu), affogato and waffles. Opened late 2024; closed Mondays.
Budget signal: physical shop.
Website: artigustogelato.com currently shows 'Squarespace – Website Expired' (they had a site; it lapsed).
Observation (from Malaysian Foodie Mar 2025): Bentong Ginger Chocolate uses a local ingredient; reviewers single out the Salted Pistachio.
Angle: kindly mention their website link shows 'expired'; our monthly Care includes hosting, SSL and uptime monitoring, so the site doesn't quietly go offline. Do not criticise their old site.

leads.name: Shiramics
leads.why: 手作陶瓷马克杯 RM70 起；以前的网站域名已失效（资料是 2022 年，要确认还在做）
leads.verify: 最近 30 天没发文就跳过
leads.input:
Shiramics · Instagram @shiramicss
Handmade ceramic mugs (handbuilding and wheel throwing) by Shafina Hanafi from Kedah; started March 2021. Mugs from RM70. Had launched 10 collections and aimed for one release a month; production runs of 30 pieces (2022 data).
Budget signal: premium pricing.
Website: shiramics.com no longer resolves (lapsed).
Observation (from The Edge / Options feature, 2022): each run is 30 pieces and takes four to six weeks.
Angle: monthly collection drops with pre-orders on her own site.

leads.name: Over Time Leathercraft
leads.why: 一人工作室的定制皮件；The Edge 2026 报道；老板预算可能不多
leads.verify: IG 简介有没有网站链接
leads.input:
Over Time Leathercraft · Instagram @over_time_leathercraft
Custom leather goods (wallets, cardholders): clients choose design, shape, size, leather and colour, with optional embossed names or initials in metallic lettering. Founder Tan Boon Leong, home studio; full-time since 2024.
Budget signal: handmade custom pricing above big fashion houses (one-person studio, so own budget may be small).
Website: none found.
Observation (from The Edge / Options feature, Apr 2026): the brand is about leather that gets better with wear and tear.
Angle: let customers pick custom options and pay a deposit on the site instead of back-and-forth DMs.

leads.name: Roost KL
leads.why: 孟沙 Telawi 开了 10 年左右的独立西餐厅，圣诞烤羊肩 / 烤全鸭外卖套餐 RM359–398，现在只能打电话订，roostkl.com 已经打不开。
leads.verify: 先看 IG 今年有没有圣诞外卖套餐的帖子，以及简介里是不是还放着 roostkl.com 这个打不开的链接。
leads.input:
What they sell / Location: Independent modern European restaurant (farm-to-fork), 69-1 Jalan Telawi 3, Bangsar Baru, KL. Festive takeaway roasts every Christmas.
Signals: Running since at least 2014 (Eat Drink KL covered Roost in Nov 2014). Listed by Tatler Dining. In SAYS' Christmas 2025 list (pre-order Angus tomahawk or beef short rib).
Budget signal: Vulcan Post Dec 2023 Christmas takeaway: roasted boneless lamb shoulder (3–5 pax) RM398+, roasted stuffed whole duck (3–5 pax) RM359+, delivery anywhere in Peninsular Malaysia via Grab Express.
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh roostkl → roostkl.com returns a Wix 'ConnectYourDomain Error' page (domain points to Wix but no live site); roost.my is for sale (not theirs); roostbangsar NONE. (b) Searched 'Roost KL order online' / 'website': only phone ordering (+603-2201 1710), no web shop, no Beepit/Oddle/StoreHub found. (c) No other brand by the owners found in coverage.
Observation: SAYS (Christmas 2025 roundup) lists Roost for pre-order Angus tomahawk / beef short rib; Vulcan Post (Dec 2023) lists the lamb shoulder and whole duck sets, ordered by phone with 3 days' notice.
Angle: Festive roast pre-order page (choose set, delivery date, pay deposit) instead of phone calls; year-round 'roast at home' sets and gift vouchers. A friendly note that roostkl.com currently shows an error page.
Sources: https://says.com/my/eats/restaurants-in-klang-valley-to-celebrate-christmas-2025 ; https://vulcanpost.com/847559/restaurants-klang-valley-christmas-takeaway-set-2023 ; https://www.eatdrinkkl.com/posts/snapshot/roost-jaslyn-cakes-telawi-bangsar ; https://www.pressreader.com/malaysia/tatler-dining-malaysia/20200101/284618899379002

leads.name: Good Blue Men
leads.contact_source: TheSmartLocal 圣诞外卖清单（2025-12）：电话 / WhatsApp 订
leads.why: PJ Section 17 Happy Mansion 开了 8 年多的咖啡馆，Tatler 推荐过；2025 圣诞烤鸡分享套餐 RM149，只能打电话或 IG 私信订。
leads.verify: 看 IG 今年圣诞有没有再做烤鸡套餐，确认简介里没有网上下单链接。
leads.input:
What they sell / Location: Independent café, AG-01 Block A, Happy Mansion, Jalan 17/13, Section 17, Petaling Jaya. Sandwiches (kam heong chicken), rice bowls, pasta; seasonal Christmas roast sets for takeaway.
Signals: Open since at least 2017 (blog reviews Aug 2017); featured in Tatler Asia's Happy Mansion guide (updated Mar 2023); in TheSmartLocal's Christmas takeaway list (13 Dec 2025).
Budget signal: Christmas 2025 Sharing Feast RM149 (whole roast chicken, truffle garlic mash, salad, garlic bread, gravy; up to 4 pax) and Roast Chicken set RM99.
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh goodbluemen / goodbluemencafe / goodbluemenmy → all NONE. (b) Searched 'Good Blue Men order online' and 'website': no own site or web shop; TheSmartLocal says orders are by call/message (012-238 5212) or Instagram DM. (c) No other brand by the founders found.
Observation: TheSmartLocal (Dec 2025) lists their Christmas Sharing Feast at RM149, ordering window 15–31 Dec, by phone or IG DM only.
Angle: Festive set pre-orders with pick-up slots and online payment; office lunch / catering orders for Section 17 offices; gift cards.
Sources: https://thesmartlocal.my/christmas-takeaways/ ; https://www.tatlerasia.com/dining/food/where-what-to-eat-happy-mansion-in-section-17-pj ; https://amandalynworld.blogspot.com/2017/08/good-blue-men-cafe-section-17-happy.html

leads.name: RATA Restaurant
leads.contact_source: TheSmartLocal 圣诞外卖清单（2025-12）：电话 / 信息订
leads.why: SS15 梳邦的现代马来西亚菜餐厅（The Star、Tatler 都写过），2025 圣诞慢烤新西兰羊腿套餐 RM199/kg，只能打电话订。
leads.verify: 看 IG 最近还有发文、今年有没有圣诞羊腿；rata.com.my 是别人的空目录，不是他们的。
leads.input:
What they sell / Location: Independent restaurant, 25 Jalan SS 15/5A, Subang Jaya. Modern Malaysian dishes with a twist (lamb ragout & mango chutney pizza, coconut lamb skewers, spicy lamb linguine). Festive lamb roasts for takeaway.
Signals: Reviewed by The Star (Feb 2019) and Eat Drink KL (2018); listed in Tatler Asia's Subang Jaya guide; in TheSmartLocal's Christmas takeaway list (13 Dec 2025).
Budget signal: Christmas 2025 slow-roasted boneless New Zealand leg of lamb set RM199/kg with sides (up to 4 pax).
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh ratasubang / ratass15 → NONE; rata.com (US company), rata.com.my ('Index of /', not theirs), ratarestaurant.com (Queenstown, NZ) are other businesses. (b) Searched 'RATA restaurant Subang' order online / website: no own site or web shop found; TheSmartLocal says orders are by call/message (012-424 1194). (c) No other brand by the owners found.
Observation: TheSmartLocal (Dec 2025): lamb leg set RM199/kg, orders from 24 Nov by phone. The Star (2019) called it 'where Malaysian food gets a modern, innovative twist'.
Angle: Festive lamb pre-order page with deposit; 'RATA at home' frozen lamb ragout / marinated skewers; party trays for Subang families.
Sources: https://thesmartlocal.my/christmas-takeaways/ ; https://www.thestar.com.my/lifestyle/food/2019/02/19/rata-subang-restaurant-review ; https://www.tatlerasia.com/dining/food/where-to-eat-subang-jaya ; https://www.eatdrinkkl.com/posts/spotlight/rata-ss15-subang

leads.name: Fluffed Café & Dessert Bar
leads.why: PJ 开了 10 年的窝夫甜点店，2025 年再开新店；农历新年 6 寸戚风蛋糕 RM168 只接预订，fluffedcafe.com 停在「Coming Soon」。
leads.verify: 看 IG 现在有几家分店、蛋糕是不是还只靠 IG 私信预订；确认 fluffedcafe.com 还是「Coming Soon」。
leads.input:
What they sell / Location: Independent dessert café known for waffles; outlets at Taman Paramount (since ~2016) and 28 Jalan PJS 8/4, Sunway Mentari, PJ; Malay Mail (Aug 2025) reports the founding duo (also behind Flurr) opened a new heritage café in Petaling Street. Pre-order celebration cakes.
Signals: Running about 10 years (Bangsar Babe review Mar 2016); Time Out listing; Malay Mail feature Aug 2025; TheSmartLocal CNY 2026 pastry list (10 Feb 2026).
Budget signal: 'Pearl of Orient' 6-inch chiffon cake RM168 (pre-order only); Nian Gao Prosperity Waffle RM33 (TheSmartLocal, Feb 2026).
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh fluffedcafe → fluffedcafe.com is a Squarespace 'Coming Soon' page (EXPIRED); fluffed.com parked (not theirs); fluffedkl / fluffedmy NONE. (b) Searched 'Fluffed cafe order' / 'website': no web shop found; TheSmartLocal says cake is pre-order via Instagram. (c) Sister brand Flurr: flurrcafe / flurrkl NONE, flurr.com is an unrelated smart-home company; no Flurr website found.
Observation: TheSmartLocal (Feb 2026) lists their CNY chiffon cake at RM168, pre-order only, contact via Instagram; Malay Mail (Aug 2025) profiled the duo building Fluffed and Flurr 'one waffle at a time'.
Angle: Cake pre-order site (size, flavour, pick-up outlet and date, lead time), festive cake drops (CNY, Mid-Autumn, Christmas), and one site covering all their outlets/brands. Their own domain is already reserved but empty.
Sources: https://thesmartlocal.my/chinese-new-year-pastries/ ; https://www.malaymail.com/news/eat-drink/2025/08/05/with-a-new-heritage-cafe-in-petaling-street-heres-how-the-duo-behind-fluffed-and-flurr-built-their-sweet-dreams-one-waffle-at-a-time/186453 ; https://www.timeout.com/kuala-lumpur/restaurants/fluffed-cafe-dessert-bar ; https://www.bangsarbabe.com/2016/03/fluffed-cafe-dessert-bar-taman-paramount.html

leads.name: Naj & Belle
leads.why: SS15 起家、现在开到孟沙 Jalan Tandok 的餐厅咖啡馆，2025 圣诞做堂食 + 外带菜单（每道 RM40–56），只放在 IG。
leads.verify: 看 IG 现在有几家分店、今年有没有圣诞外带；确认简介没有网上下单链接（2018 年的评论提过一个网站，现在打不开）。
leads.input:
What they sell / Location: Independent café-restaurant; started in SS15 Courtyard, Subang Jaya (reviewed 2018), later KL East Mall, now Jalan Tandok, Bangsar. Fusion comfort food; festive potluck-style menu for dine-in and takeaway.
Signals: Operating since at least 2018 (Discover KL review Aug 2018); SAYS Christmas 2025 roundup plus a dedicated SAYS story on their Christmas 2025 menu; Malaysian Foodie feature (Sep 2025).
Budget signal: Christmas 2025 menu: smoked spring chicken RM56, Swedish meatballs RM45, miso capellini with scallops RM45, beef pot pie RM40 (each 1–2 pax) → about RM40+ per person.
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh najnbelle / najandbelle / najnbellemy → all NONE (a 2018 review mentioned a website; it no longer resolves). (b) Searched 'Naj & Belle Bangsar order online' / 'website': no web shop found; SAYS only points to Instagram @najnbelle. (c) No other brand by the owners found.
Observation: SAYS (Nov 2025) 'Naj & Belle Bangsar's Christmas menu brings homely festive flavours in a small, easygoing menu', available from 20 Nov for dine-in and takeaway.
Angle: Festive takeaway pre-orders (pick date, pay online), party trays, a simple menu + location site replacing the dead old domain.
Sources: https://says.com/my/lifestyle/eats/naj-and-belle-christmas-2025 ; https://says.com/my/eats/restaurants-in-klang-valley-to-celebrate-christmas-2025 ; https://www.malaysianfoodie.com/2025/09/naj-belle-where-local-traditions-meet-modern-indulgence.html ; https://discoverkl.com/2018/08/09/naj-belle-ss15-subang-jaya-food-review
